Legal

Privacy notice.

Last updated: 19 November 2026

The enquiry form does not store your details on this website. It prepares a WhatsApp message that you can review before sending.

Information you choose to send

Your message may include your name or artist name, contact detail, requested service, track count, preferred date, target release date, demo link and project notes.

Why it is used

Thinkin’ Sounds uses the information to respond to your enquiry, recommend a service, prepare a quote, arrange a booking and deliver work you approve. Please do not include information that is not needed for the enquiry.

Studio accounts and recording bookings

If you create a studio account, Supabase processes your email and sign-in details for authentication. Booking records contain the account identifier, requested date and time, session duration, number of attendees and booking status. Thinkin’ Sounds uses these records to manage studio bookings and contact you about your session, including the deposit and confirmation.

WhatsApp and external links

When you continue to WhatsApp, your use of that service is also governed by WhatsApp’s own privacy terms. Demo links are handled by the service where you host them.

Sharing and retention

Information is shared only where needed to respond, provide the requested service or meet a legal obligation. Enquiry and booking records should be kept only as long as reasonably necessary for those purposes.

Your choices and rights

You may ask what personal information Thinkin’ Sounds holds about you and request correction or deletion where applicable. You can also choose not to send the prepared WhatsApp message.

Contact

For a privacy request, message Gareth on 082 653 5019 or Joshua on 081 251 6522.
